analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free caused by reusing a single scratch SkGlyphRunBuilder across LOOPER iterations in SkCanvas::onDrawText. The builder stores a moved/copied SkPaint inside fScratchGlyphRun; on each drawText call, SkGlyphRunBuilder::initialize() explicitly destroys the previous fScratchGlyphRun (SkGlyphRun.cpp:181), which drops refs (including PathEffect). In onDrawText, the first iteration builds glyphRun from looper.paint(), then before that glyphRun is consumed safely for all use paths, a subsequent iteration reinitializes/destroys the same scratch run, freeing the previous paint’s PathEffect. Later draw code (SkDraw::drawPosText_asPaths) copies the stale paint and ref()s the freed PathEffect, triggering UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered when drawText executes through LOOPER with multiple iterations (e.g., looper/layer effects active) and text rendering takes the drawPosText_asPaths path. Dataflow: fuzz harness fuzz_canvas case 45 configures SkPaint (including PathEffect via fuzz_paint -> make_fuzz_patheffect), then canvas->drawText(). onDrawText uses fScratchGlyphRunBuilder->drawText()/useGlyphRun() per iteration; builder destruction/reuse invalidates prior run paint state, and later device drawing references freed PathEffect.
